# spo_org_assets_library (Resource)

Registers a document library as an organization assets library (Add/Get/Set/Remove-SPOOrgAssetsLibrary, CSOM), keyed by the library URL. Surfaces its images/templates/fonts to the org.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Register a document library as an organization assets library so its
# images / templates / fonts surface across the org. The tenant Office 365 CDN
# must be enabled for the chosen cdn_type (Public or Private, default Private).
resource "spo_org_assets_library" "brand_images" {
  identity       = "https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/brand/SiteAssets"
  org_asset_type = "ImageDocumentLibrary" # or OfficeTemplateLibrary / OfficeFontLibrary
  cdn_type       = "Private"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Name (Identity) of the object; also the create key. Changing it forces replacement.
- `org_asset_type` (String) Asset type: ImageDocumentLibrary, OfficeTemplateLibrary or OfficeFontLibrary.

### Optional

- `cdn_type` (String) CDN the library is served from: Public or Private (default Private). Changing it forces replacement.
- `thumbnail_url` (String) Optional thumbnail image URL for the library.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
